node.title: Rate-half distance-three pair-Lagrange normal form
node.statement: On the official exceptional-only quotient-distance-three chart, normalize Q(0;X)=A(X). The e internal fibers partition the 2e exceptional roots into pairs D_i and determine the entire residual generator by Q(z;X)=Phi(z)A(X)+zB_T(X) sum_i (lambda_i/xi_i)L_i(z)A(X)/D_i(X), where xi_i are the internal slopes and L_i their Lagrange basis. The displayed X-side and parameter-side families are both independent, so this is a minimal rank-(e+1) separated expansion. The external split-fiber classification remains open.
